task_spec: AliasGenerator handling must distinguish 'no alias / no generator' (None) from a validly-produced falsy alias (e.g. empty string). Use 'is not None' checks, not truthiness, so falsy generated aliases are not silently dropped. (pydantic/pydantic#13248)

bugs.description: Alias handling uses truthiness instead of `is not None`. `if alias_generator := getattr(...)` and `if alias and not isinstance(...)` treat a validly-produced but falsy alias (e.g. empty string '') as absent, so a falsy generated alias is silently dropped and its type is never validated. Correct is explicit `is not None` checks.
